10201.meaning1: with holes below; with cracks underneath

examples.text: navacchiddan'ti cakkhusot'ādīhi navahi vaṇamukhehi chidda-avacchiddehi yuttattā navacchiddaṃ.
na kabaḷa-avacchedakaṃ bhuñjissāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.

10206.meaning1: with holes below; with cracks underneath
10206.commentary: (ANa) chidd'āvachiddan'ti parittamahantehi chiddehi samannāgataṃ… navahi vaṇamukhehi parittamahanta chiddaṃ.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhante, puriso medakathālikaṃ parihareyya chidda-avachiddaṃ uggharantaṃ paggharantaṃ, evam'evaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhante, imaṃ kāyaṃ pariharāmi chidda-avachiddaṃ uggharantaṃ paggharantaṃ.
bhūtena kho pana vuccamāno avajānāti, no paṭijānāti. abhūtena vuccamāno na ātappaṃ karoti, tassa nibbeṭhanāya iti'p'etaṃ atacchaṃ iti'p'etaṃ abhūtan'ti.

10210.meaning1: despises; disdains; looks down (on); is condescending (to)
10210.commentary: (SNPa) pare ca mavajānātī'ti tehi'y'eva pare avajānāti, nīcaṃ karoti. ma-kāro padasandhikaro.

examples.text: yo c'attānaṃ samukkaṃse, pare ca m'avajānāti, nihīno sena mānena, taṃ jaññā vasalo iti.

10213.meaning1: having denied; having disagreed; having not accepted

10218.commentary: (NIDD1a) avajje vajjasaññitā'ti niddose dosasaññitā. (VVt) avajjan'ti vajjarahitaṃ, niddosan'ti attho.

examples.text: avajje vajjamatino, vajje cāvajjadassino, micchādiṭṭhisamādānā, sattā gacchanti duggatiṃ.
lūnakesī paṅkadharī, ekasāṭī pure cariṃ, avajje vajjamatinī, vajje c'āvajjadassinī.

na > a + √vajj + a + to
avajja + to

lūnakesī paṅkadharī, ekasāṭī pure cariṃ, avajje vajjamatinī, vajje ca-avajjadassinī.

10222.meaning1: (of a being) not to be killed; inviolable; sacrosanct
10222.meaning2: not to be killed or punished
10222.commentary: (SNPa) te evaṃ namassiyamānā lokena avajjhā brāhmaṇā āsuṃ (JAa) kaṃ avajjhaṃ ghātemī'ti aghātetabbam'pi kaṃ ghātemi attano ñātīnaṃ udikkhamānānaññ'eva, akkhāhi me'ti pucchati.

examples.text: avajjhā brāhmaṇā āsuṃ, ajeyyā dhammarakkhitā, na ne koci nivāresi, kuladvāresu sabbaso.
kiṃ kammam'akaraṃ pubbe, kaṃ avajjhaṃ aghātayi, kibbisaṃ yaṃ karitvāna, idaṃ dukkhaṃ upāgami.
so kāmarāgaṃ'y'eva antaraṃ katvā jhāyati pajjhāyati nijjhāyati avajjhāyati.
idh'āvuso, dhammayogā bhikkhū jhāyī bhikkhū apasādenti, ime pana jhāyino'mhā, jhāyino'mhā'ti jhāyanti pajjhāyanti nijjhāyanti avajjhāyanti
yathā sākaṭiko maṭṭhaṃ, samaṃ hitvā mahāpathaṃ, visamaṃ maggam'āruyha, akkhacchinno-avajhāyati.

10228.commentary: (ANa) avañjhānī'ti atucchāni saphalāni saudrayānī'ti attho. (PVa) avañjhānī'ti amoghāni anipphalāni.

examples.text: tesaṃ te kārā amhesu mahapphalā bhavissanti mah'ānisaṃsā, amhākañ'c'ev'āyaṃ pabbajjā avañjhā bhavissati saphalā saudrayā'ti. evañ'hi vo, bhikkhave, sikkhitabbaṃ.
evaṃ no ayaṃ amhākaṃ pabbajjā avaṅkatā avañjhā bhavissati saphalā saudrayā.

10229.meaning1: I (say they are) certainly not barren
10229.commentary: (ANa) avañjhānī'ti atucchāni saphalāni saudrayānī'ti attho. (PVa) avañjhānī'ti amoghāni anipphalāni.

examples.text: iti kho, bhikkhave, paripūraṃ paripūrakārī ārādheti padesaṃ padesakārī. avañjhānitv'ev'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, sikkhāpadāni vadāmī'ti.

10231.meaning1: despised; disdained; disrespected; looked down upon

examples.text: hīnaṃ nāma nāmaṃ, avakaṇṇakaṃ, javakaṇṇakaṃ, dhaniṭṭhakaṃ, saviṭṭhakaṃ, kulavaḍḍhakaṃ, tesu tesu vā pana janapadesu oññātaṃ avaññātaṃ hīḷitaṃ paribhūtaṃ acittīkataṃ, etaṃ hīnaṃ nāma nāmaṃ.
tayā sudantena avaṭṭhitena hi, hayena yogg'ācariyo'va ujjunā, pahomi maggaṃ paṭipajjituṃ sivaṃ, citt'ānurakkhīhi sadā nisevitaṃ.

10237.commentary: (NIDD1a) api ca sampayuttadhamme ārammaṇamhi sampiṇḍetvā tiṭṭhatī'ti saṇṭhiti. ārammaṇaṃ ogāhetvā anupavisitvā tiṭṭhatī'ti avaṭṭhiti.

examples.text: yato ca kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvakassa ariyañāṇaṃ uppannaṃ hoti, atha catunnaṃ indriyānaṃ saṇṭhiti hoti, atha catunnaṃ indriyānaṃ avaṭṭhiti hoti.

pātimokkhan'ti sīlaṃ patiṭṭhā ādi caraṇaṃ saṃyamo saṃvaro mukhaṃ pamukhaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā. atha vā'pi samādhin'ti yā cittassa ṭhiti saṇṭhiti avaṭṭhiti avisāhāro avikkhepo avisāhatamānasatā samatho samādh'indriyaṃ samādhibalaṃ sammāsamādhī'ti, pātimokkhaṃ atha vā'pi samādhiṃ.

10239.grammar: fem, abstr, from na vaḍḍhati, neg

10240.meaning1: loss and ruin; misfortune and destruction

examples.text: anayan'ti avaḍḍhiṃ. byasanan'ti vināsaṃ. anayabyasanan'ti avaḍḍhivināsaṃ
anuvicca pariyogāhetvā avaṇṇa-arahassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, anuvicca pariyogāhetvā vaṇṇ'ārahassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati
tasmā't'iha, phagguna, tava ce'pi sammukhā avaṇṇaṃ bhāseyya, tatrā'pi tvaṃ, phagguna, ye gehasitā chandā ye gehasitā vitakkā te pajaheyyāsi.

idha, bhikkhave, asappuriso yo hoti parassa avaṇṇo taṃ apuṭṭho'pi pātu karoti, ko pana vādo puṭṭhassa! puṭṭho kho pana pañh'ābhinīto ahāpetvā alambitvā paripūraṃ vitthārena parassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsitā hoti.

evaṃ saṃsaṭṭho āyasmā moḷiyaphagguno bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ viharati, sace koci bhikkhu āyasmato moḷiyaphaggunassa sammukhā tāsaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, ten'āyasmā moḷiyaphagguno kupito anattamano adhikaraṇam'pi karoti.

10244.meaning1: wanting to discredit; wanting to disparage

examples.text: eso kho, bhante, avaṇṇakāmo buddhassa, avaṇṇakāmo dhammassa, avaṇṇakāmo saṅghassa. sādhu, bhante, bhagavā muhuttaṃ nisīdatu anukampaṃ upādāyā'ti.

10245.meaning1: criticizes; speaks dispraise (of); says something bad (about)
10245.commentary: (MNa) avaṇṇaṃ bhāsatī'ti tā pana pacanakoṭṭan'ādīni karontiyo disvā n'atthi imāsaṃ anāpatti nāma, imā bhikkhuniyo anācārā dubbacā pagabbhāti aguṇaṃ katheti.

examples.text: evaṃ saṃsaṭṭho āyasmā moḷiyaphagguno bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ viharati, sace koci bhikkhu āyasmato moḷiyaphaggunassa sammukhā tāsaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, ten'āyasmā moḷiyaphagguno kupito anattamano adhikaraṇam'pi karoti.
anuvicca pariyogāhetvā avaṇṇ'ārahassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati anuvicca pariyogāhetvā vaṇṇ'ārahassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati
anuvicca pariyogāhetvā avaṇṇ'ārahassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, anuvicca pariyogāhetvā vaṇṇ'ārahassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati
idha, potaliya, ekacco puggalo avaṇṇ'ārahassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsitā hoti bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ kālena, no ca kho vaṇṇ'ārahassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsitā hoti bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ kālena.

10253.commentary: (SNa) no ce assaddhiyaṃ avatiṭṭhatī'ti yadi assaddhiyaṃ na tiṭṭhati.

examples.text: saddhā dutiyā purisassa hoti, no ce assaddhiyaṃ avatiṭṭhati, yaso ca kittī ca tatv'assa hoti, saggañ'ca so gacchati sarīraṃ vihāyā'ti.
seyyathā'pi balavā saṅkhadhamo appakasiren'eva catuddisā viññāpeyya, evam'eva kho evaṃ bhāvitāya mettāya cetovimuttiyā yaṃ pamāṇakataṃ kammaṃ na taṃ tatr'āvasissati, na taṃ tatra-avatiṭṭhati.

10254.commentary: (PYt) sokaṃ avataratī'ti sok'āvatiṇṇā, janatā. sok'āvatiṇṇañ'ca jātijar'ābhibhūtañ'cā'ti casaddo yojetabbo. iminā casaddo luttaniddiṭṭho'ti dasseti.

examples.text: sele yathā pabbatamuddhaniṭṭhito, yathā'pi passe janataṃ samantato, tath'ūpamaṃ dhammamayaṃ sumedho, pāsādam'āruyha samantacakkhu, soka-avatiṇṇaṃ janatam'apetasoko, avekkhati jātijar'ābhibhūtan'ti.

10255.grammar: nt, act, from na vattati, neg
10255.meaning1: not occurring; not happening; not continuing; not existing

10256.meaning2: should not be said; should not be told; should not be spoken

10258.base: √ṭhā + āpe + īya > ṭhāpīya > thapīya (caus, pass, irreg)

examples.text: evaṃ sante mama bhātu guṇo sakalajambudīpe avattharitvā gamissati, candimasūriyo viya paññāyissatī'ti.

10265.synonym: ṭhāna, dhātu, patha, pada, bhāva, vuttitā, saṅkhāra, samaya

examples.text: atha vā sammā gatattā'ti tīsu'pi avatthāsu sammāpaṭipattiyā gatattā, suppaṭipannattā'ti attho.
tasmā tīsu'pi avatthāsu sabbasattesu samānarasāya tathāya mahākaruṇāya sakalalokahitāya gato paṭipanno'ti tathāgato. evaṃ tathāya gato'ti tathāgato.

10269.meaning1: spreading over; covering over; strewing down
10269.commentary: (VINa) tiṇ'avatthārakena vūpasameyyā'ti ettha idaṃ kammaṃ tiṇ'avatthārakasadisattā tiṇ'avatthārako'ti vuttaṃ. yathā hi gūthaṃ vā muttaṃ vā ghaṭṭiyamānaṃ duggandhatāya bādhati, tiṇehi avattharitvā suppaṭicchāditassa pan'assa so gandho na bādhati, evam'eva yaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ mūl'ānumūlaṃ gantvā vūpasamiyamānaṃ kakkhaḷattāya vāḷattāya bhedāya saṃvattati, taṃ iminā kammena vūpasantaṃ gūthaṃ viya tiṇ'avatthārakena paṭicchannaṃ suvūpasantaṃ hotī'ti idaṃ kammaṃ tiṇ'avatthārakasadisattā tiṇ'avatthārako'ti vuttaṃ.

examples.text: siyā'pi taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ kakkhaḷattāya vāḷattāya bhedāya saṃvatteyyā'ti, anujānāmi, bhikkhave, evarūpaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ tiṇ'avatthārakena vūpasametuṃ.
yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ tiṇ'avatthārakena vūpasameyya, ṭhapetvā thullavajjaṃ, ṭhapetvā gihippaṭisaṃyuttan'ti.
dutiyo musalo paripatitvā aññatarassa dārakassa matthake avatthāsi. so kālam'akāsi.

10271.meaning1: stood firmly; placed; steady; continuing; lasting
10271.meaning2: standing firmly; placed; steady; continuing; lasting

10272.meaning1: continuously undertaking; persistently taking upon oneself

10273.meaning1: without base; without grounds; without foundation
10273.commentary: (ANa) tāl'āvatthukatānī'ti tālavatthu viya katāni, puna aviruhaṇ'aṭṭhena matthakacchinnatālo viya samūlaṃ tālaṃ uddharitvā tassa patiṭṭhitaṭṭhānaṃ viya ca katānī'ti attho.

examples.text: idh'āvuso, bhikkhu rāgo me pahīno ucchinnamūlo tāla-avatthukato anabhāvaṃkato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo'ti pajānāti

avatthu + ka

10275.grammar: abs of na vadati, neg, trans (+acc)

examples.text: atha mahāsatto hiyyo me dve'pi dārake brāhmaṇassa dinnā, aham'pi araññe ekako'va, kathaṃ te maddiṃ sīlavantiṃ patibbataṃ dassāmī'ti avatvā'va pasāritahatthe anaggharatanaṃ ṭhapento viya asajjitvā abajjhitvā anolīnamānaso ajja me dānapāramī matthakaṃ pāpuṇissatī'ti haṭṭhatuṭṭho giriṃ unnādento viya

10276.grammar: prp of na vadati, neg, intrans

examples.text: evaṃ maṃ avadantaṃ yo evaṃ puccheyya, kissa nu kho, bhante, viññāṇ'āhāro'ti, esa kallo pañho.

10279.grammar: adj, from sk na vadānya, neg
10279.commentary: (SNPa) avagamanatāya maccharitāya buddh'ādīnaṃ vacanaṃ anādiyanatāya ca avadāniyā.
10279.notes:
PED suggests ava + dā (cut)
CPD and Cone suggest sk a + vadānya

examples.text: kāmesu giddhā pasutā pamūḷhā, avadāniyā te visame niviṭṭhā, dukkh'ūpanītā paridevayanti, kiṃsū bhavissāma ito cutāse.

10282.commentary: (MNa) udar'āvadehakan'ti udarapūraṃ. tañ'hi udaraṃ avadehanato udar'āvadehakan'ti vuccati.

examples.text: yo so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu yāva'd'atthaṃ udara-avadehakaṃ bhuñjitvā seyyasukhaṃ passasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ anuyutto viharati, tassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya.
etadatthā, bhikkhave, kathā, etadatthā mantanā, etadatthā upanisā, etadatthaṃ sota-avadhānaṃ, yadidaṃ anupādā cittassa vimokkho'ti.
caggahaṇam'avadhāraṇa-atthaṃ, pabhaṅ'karo, amataṅ'dado, medhaṅ'karo, dīpaṅ'karo.
adhikāre maṅgale c'eva, nipphanne ca-avadhāraṇe, anantare c'apādāne, athasaddo pavattati.
akkocchi maṃ avadhi maṃ, ajini maṃ ahāsi me, ye ca taṃ upanayhanti, veraṃ tesaṃ na sammati.

10297.commentary: (MNa) vaṭṭan'āvaḷī'ti yathā rajjuyā āvunitvā katā vaṭṭan'āvaḷī vaṭṭanānaṃ antar'antarā ninnā hoti, vaṭṭanaṭṭhānesu unnatā, evaṃ piṭṭhikaṇṭako unnat'āvanato hoti.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma vaṭṭan'āvaḷī, evam'ev'assu me piṭṭhikaṇṭako uṇṇata-avanato hoti tāy'ev'app'āhāratāya.
